decks.summary: Guide Ascetic George with two dozen skills like Grim Resolve, Unrelenting and Sharp Vision to discard beneath him and commit later, with Nautical Charts and Lawrence Carlisle for clues.
Super-high-draw flex George who spams skills, recurs A Glimmer of Hope, and fights with Fire Axe under Dark Horse and Madame Labranche; tested through a Drowned City blind run.
Heist George who pairs Quick Learner with Leo De Luca for two -2 difficulty actions a turn, cutting shroud to 0 with Flashlight, Old Keyring, Matchbox, Gumption and Shed a Light.
Level 0 Forced Learning George who discards Nautical Charts, Glimmer of Hope and Winging It for 2 to 4 clues an action, with Occult Lexicon, Hand Hook and Pushed to the Limit.
The 16 XP follow-up to Forcibly Learning to Sail: Scavenging returns Nautical Charts every turn, with Cornered, Gift of Nodens and Sharp Vision, for three clues and a card per action.
Three-domain George who uses hand, the cards beneath him and the discard pile, drawing two a round with Forced Learning and replaying A Glimmer of Hope and Scrounge for Supplies.
Pre-release level 0 George on Forced Learning who stays poor for Dark Horse and Madame Labranche, swinging Fire Axe and Meat Cleaver and committing skills from beneath him.
A deliberately silly Ascetic George who exiles Burn After Reading, Flare and A Test of Will from the start and buys them back with Déjà Vu, burning Signum Crucis for doom removal.
Infinite Boat George who loops Brute Force, Sharp Vision and Long Shot through Gift of Nodens for 2 to 3 clues or 3+ damage, raising his hand size with Cornered and Artistic Inspiration.
A 34 XP take on George's Boatload of Skills with Research Librarians for Nautical Charts, True Survivor to replay skills, and Gift of Nodens and Scrapper at the top end.
